courses.title: Commercial Asset Ownership, Financial Modeling & Enterprise Growth
courses.summary: Core institutional masterclass on building real, defensible wealth in Nigeria through physical commercial assets, legal due diligence, cash-flow structuring, and risk mitigation.
courses.description: Designed for entrepreneurs, professionals, and prospective asset owners. Learn how to evaluate real estate titles, structure commercial asset purchases, manage business cash flow, protect assets from macroeconomic volatility, and develop scalable business ventures.
courses.instructorName: Dr. Folashade Adeleke & Engr. Tunde Coker
courses.instructorTitle: Asset Valuation Lead & Commercial Enterprise Advisor

lessons.title: Module 1: Principles of Real Wealth Creation & Asset Classes in Nigeria
lessons.description: Distinguishing productive assets from speculative schemes. Understanding commercial real estate, logistics fleets, enterprise infrastructure, and cash-flow generators.

lessons.title: Module 2: Legal Title Due Diligence, Conveyance & Cadastral Searches
lessons.description: Forensic property search protocols: verifying Certificates of Occupancy (C of O), Governor’s Consent, Gazette Excisions, and avoiding communal disputes.

lessons.title: Module 3: Enterprise Financial Modeling & Capital Structure
lessons.description: Building practical financial models, cash-flow projections, working capital management, and cost-of-capital benchmarking in emerging markets.

lessons.title: Module 4: Logistics, Fleet & Supply Chain Asset Economics
lessons.description: Evaluating commercial haulage economics, maintenance reserves, telematics, and structured commercial freight contracts.

lessons.title: Module 5: Digital Opportunities & Scaling Modern Business Ventures
lessons.description: Leveraging digital platforms, inventory software, and automated billing to scale regional Nigerian businesses into national brands.

courses.title: Executive Agribusiness Management & Commercial Farm Economics
courses.summary: Specialized executive masterclass covering agro-ecological economics, precision soil optimization, mechanization procurement, and corporate offtake contracts.
courses.description: Led by seasoned agronomists and commercial agricultural financiers, teaching practical operational frameworks for profitable crop production and agro-processing in Nigeria without speculative guesswork.
courses.instructorTitle: Principal Agronomist & Former Director of Crop Strategy

lessons.title: Module 1: Agro-Ecological Zones & Commercial Crop Viability in Nigeria
lessons.description: Understanding rainfall distributions, soil horizons, and climatic suitability across the South-West, Middle Belt, and Northern economic corridors.

lessons.title: Module 2: Land Due Diligence, Title Verification, and Community Engagement
lessons.description: Crucial legal steps to verify C of O, Gazette, Excision, Survey plans, and building lasting relations with host communities in agricultural zones.

lessons.title: Module 3: Precision Irrigation, Soil Remediation, and Fertilizer Optimization
lessons.description: Calculating drip emitter spacing, soil organic amendments, micro-nutrients dosing, and water borehole volume calculations.

lessons.title: Module 4: Mechanization & Agricultural Machinery Fleet Management
lessons.description: Tractor implement selection (disc ploughs, harrows, ridgers, seed drills) and diesel consumption benchmarking.

lessons.title: Module 5: Post-Harvest Loss Mitigation & Cold-Chain Transit Protocols
lessons.description: Proper harvesting maturity indices, sorting sheds, evaporative pre-cooling, and transit reefer set-points.

lessons.title: Module 6: Enterprise Financial Modeling & Market Offtaker Contracts
lessons.description: Drafting structured forward contracts with corporate food processors, FMCG buyers, and export off-takers.
